pages.content:
# Best AI Agent for Coding: How to Choose for Your Repository and Team

There is no universal coding-agent winner. The right choice depends on the repository, language stack, editor or terminal workflow, need for cloud execution, review process, model access, organizational controls, and budget. Compare candidates on the same task rather than on unrelated demos.

## Evaluation workflow

Start with a representative issue that is small enough to review but meaningful enough to require repository context. Record how each tool plans the work, which files it reads, what commands it executes, how it reports uncertainty, whether it can run tests, and how easily a developer can inspect and revert the result. Keep secrets out of prompts and restrict write permissions during early trials.

## Current product surfaces

Official product documentation shows that modern coding agents span editor, terminal, GitHub, app, CLI and cloud-agent experiences. Those surfaces change quickly, so this page avoids stale labels such as assuming a product is only an API or only an autocomplete tool. Pricing and included model access should be checked directly before purchase.

## Evidence policy

Historical Google Search visibility preserves this URL but does not bypass evidence gates. Material claims must remain traceable to current primary documentation. Missing evidence means HOLD rather than a fabricated score or ranking.
